title: The acp table of a provider entry (kumikit.provider-acp)

command.description: Program to start; must be in the declaring plugin's permissions.spawn.

secret-env.description: Variable name to secret name; each secret must be in permissions.secrets.

model-arg.description: Flag that selects the model on the agent's command line, followed by the model id.

mode.description: Session mode to set after opening (session/set_mode).

auth-method.description: ACP authentication method id to call with authenticate after initialize, for agents that require it before opening a session.
